text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka is in my office, ostensibly with some sort of request.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Listen to this, Trainer. I only slept for four hours last night!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I was up workin' on my arms, and then it just got so late.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, four hours might not be enough for some, but it's more than enough for me…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh! That wasn't 'cause I'm sleepy or anything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever since then, Vodka has been staying up late in order to brag about not needing sleep…
